using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MAXV = 10005;
const int SRC = MAXV - 2;
const int SNK = MAXV - 1;
const int MAXE = 2000000 + 10;
const int INF = 2000000000;

int first[MAXV], to[MAXE], nxt[MAXE], cap_e[MAXE], cost_e[MAXE], edge_cnt = 1;
queue<int> que;
ll dis[MAXV];
bool used[MAXV];

inline void add_edge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
    to[++edge_cnt] = v; nxt[edge_cnt] = first[u]; first[u] = edge_cnt;
    cap_e[edge_cnt] = flow; cost_e[edge_cnt] = cost;
    to[++edge_cnt] = u; nxt[edge_cnt] = first[v]; first[v] = edge_cnt;
    cap_e[edge_cnt] = 0; cost_e[edge_cnt] = -cost;
}

inline bool spfa() {
    memset(used, 0, sizeof(used));
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(dis));
    que.push(SNK); dis[SNK] = 0; used[SNK] = 1;
    while (!que.empty()) {
        int x = que.front(); que.pop();
        used[x] = 0;
        for (int i = first[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = to[i];
            if (cap_e[i ^ 1] && dis[y] > dis[x] + cost_e[i ^ 1]) {
                dis[y] = dis[x] + cost_e[i ^ 1];
                if (!used[y]) { que.push(y); used[y] = 1; }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[SRC] < 1e18;
}

inline int dfs(int x, int lim, ll &total) {
    int flow = 0;
    used[x] = 1;
    if (x == SNK) return lim;
    for (int i = first[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int y = to[i];
        if (!cap_e[i] || used[y]) continue;
        if (dis[x] != dis[y] + cost_e[i]) continue;
        int t = dfs(y, min(cap_e[i], lim - flow), total);
        cap_e[i] -= t;
        cap_e[i ^ 1] += t;
        flow += t;
        total += t * cost_e[i];
        if (flow == lim) return lim;
    }
    return flow;
}

inline ll min_cost_flow() {
    int all_flow = 0;
    ll total = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        do {
            memset(used, 0, sizeof(used));
            all_flow += dfs(SRC, INF, total);
        } while (used[SNK]);
    }
    return total;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, k, c, d, lim = 101;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x; cin >> x; --x;
        add_edge(SRC, x, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++)
        add_edge(i * n, SNK, k, c * i);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < lim - 1; j++)
            add_edge(i + j * n, i + (j + 1) * n, k, 0);
    while (m--) {
        int x, y; cin >> x >> y; --x; --y;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim - 1; i++)
            for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                add_edge(x + i * n, y + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                add_edge(y + i * n, x + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
    }
    cout << min_cost_flow();
    return 0;
}

    int src, sink;
    queue<int> q;
    ll dis[MAXV];

        memset(head, 0, sizeof(head));

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int w) {
        to[++edgeCnt] = v; nxt[edgeCnt] = head[u]; head[u] = edgeCnt;
        cap[edgeCnt] = flow; cost[edgeCnt] = w;
        to[++edgeCnt] = u; nxt[edgeCnt] = head[v]; head[v] = edgeCnt;
        cap[edgeCnt] = 0; cost[edgeCnt] = -w;
    }

    bool spfa() {
        memset(inq, 0, sizeof(inq));
        memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(dis));
        q.push(sink); dis[sink] = 0; inq[sink] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.front(); q.pop();
            inq[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
                int y = to[i];
                if (cap[i ^ 1] && dis[y] > dis[x] + cost[i ^ 1]) {
                    dis[y] = dis[x] + cost[i ^ 1];
                    if (!inq[y]) { q.push(y); inq[y] = true; }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[src] < 1e18;

    int dfs(int x, int lim, ll &totalCost) {
        int flow = 0;
        inq[x] = true;
        if (x == sink) return lim;
        for (int i = head[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = to[i];
            if (!cap[i] || inq[y]) continue;
            if (dis[x] != dis[y] + cost[i]) continue;
            int t = dfs(y, min(cap[i], lim - flow), totalCost);

            cap[i ^ 1] += t;
            flow += t;
            totalCost += t * cost[i];
            if (flow == lim) return lim;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    ll run() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        ll totalCost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            do {
                memset(inq, 0, sizeof(inq));
                totalFlow += dfs(src, INF, totalCost);
            } while (inq[sink]);
        }
        return totalCost;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, c, d, lim = 101;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
